answer: A stake-backed trust trellis stops Sybils: each new agent needs two established vouchers who lock collateral, slashed if the recruit cheats. To mint a zephyr swarm of fakes, an attacker must also buy honest vouchers along every edge; each is capped and priced, so cost climbs superlinearly with account count. A raven auditor samples attestations, raising the chance any fake is caught and its backers ruined.
